## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Why use-stellar?

**Figma frame:** _Why use-stellar?_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-19 (cards, badges, and tags), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Benefit-driven overview presenting key reasons to adopt the library (trust, DX, consistency).

### What to design (in Figma)

- Benefit-led heading and introduction.
- A clear treatment for trust, developer experience, and consistency benefits.
- Responsive card or content layout that preserves equal emphasis across benefits.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile benefit-overview frames.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Trust, DX, and consistency are each represented clearly
- [ ] Benefit content is easy to scan and compare
- [ ] Uses UI-17 tokens, UI-19 components where applicable, and UI-20 grid rules
- [ ] Dark-mode contrast is sufficient for all content
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
